messages.subject: Explain Outputs of Lavaan
parts:
Dear professor, 

 

I'm interested in applying lavaan.survey package for my research. However, the I have difficulties to explain the output as well as evaluate model fit. 

So I would like to ask your help as follows: 

 

1) How to evaluate model fit for the following outputs? Because there are also the Robust column value

 

2) Do the outputs in Robust column play important role to evaluate model fit?

 

3) Is this model fit?

 

I hope to hear your help for explaining the outputs. Thank you so much! 

Best regards, 

Dang.

............................................................................

 

> library(lavaan.survey)

> mod<-' TRICH~ TP + NP

+ TDEN ~ TRICH + TP + NP

+ NP ~ 0*TP'

> fit.ten <- sem(mod, data = ten, fixed.x = FALSE, estimator = "MLM")

> des.ten <- svydesign(ids = ~site, random= ~time, probs = ~1, data = ten)

> fit.ten.survey <- lavaan.survey(fit.ten, des.ten, estimator = "MLM")

> summary(fit.ten.survey, fit.measures=TRUE)

2) Do the outputs in Robust column play important role to evaluate model fit?
